title: R-Law I two-channel origin audit v3.1

single_channel_obstruction.statement: A scalar Information-Time realization has zero set ker(DPhi_x), one linear subspace on a two-dimensional plane when DPhi_x is nonzero.

two_channel_product_mechanism.statement: For independent L_plus and L_minus, abs(L_plus(v)L_minus(v))/H has zero set ker(L_plus) union ker(L_minus), and q(v)=L_plus(v)L_minus(v) has det(G)<0.

native_two_channel_origin.warning: Defining L_plus and L_minus from already computed TESC null rays is circular.

claim_boundary: This audit certifies a scalar no-go and a conditional two-channel algebraic mechanism. It does not derive native L_plus, L_minus, their product law, or physical zero-set binding from Principle R.
